name: Ultimate Light Rail
summary: Light rail stations: surface, underground or elevated, with five lengths and covered platforms.
description: Ultimate Light Rail 0.14.0 adds full-length elevated platform decks and native modern railway-platform canopies. The platform floor, canopy and safety railing follow the entire structural deck, including the terminus crossover sides. Selected platform length remains the usable stopping length. Roof columns are placed outside stair openings; catenary poles stand on outboard concrete brackets. The central ground entrance gains two small trees, four planted beds and open frontage for a separately placed native bus stop. No automatic or integrated bus stop is created. Elevated tracks remain at +12m with 10.4m clearance below crossbeams. Ground street snapping and placement were confirmed working in 0.13.2. This visual update preserves vehicle paths, station stop positions and the central pedestrian connection. All five lengths, both station types and approach fence choices remain available. Surface and underground variants are unchanged. Place a new elevated station to see the new appearance; no automatic rebuilding. The new canopies and landscaping require an in-game visual/collision test. Do not remove the mod while its infrastructure remains in a save.
